Review110h findings 1–2 resolve bus-width dependencies on demand before consulting bounds, reject width cycles, and choose generated fairness binders fresh against every global declaration. Finding 3 remains rejected and the parser is unchanged.

review110f_fixes.flattened_signal_names: Reject any signal declaration named <bus>_<i> for an actual declared bus bit, after resolving widths and parameter overrides; preserve injective identity in all expanded formats.
review110f_fixes.recursive_arguments: TLSF v1.1 section 4.3 signal/boolean embedding into LTL remains available in recursive signatures; boolean-only constraints still narrow masks and logical operands.
review110f_fixes.enum_widths: Static checks are exact only for direct unshadowed bus declarations. Runtime checks use the actual bus after argument substitution, lexical shadowing, branch selection and set difference/intersection.
review110f_fixes.bus_aliases: Resolve lexical definitions and actuals to the declared bus before indexing, SIZEOF and identity-key expansion.
review110f_fixes.regressions: 571 CLI cases, including 30 exact third-review probes; C units cover boolean-only recursive guards in both inference orders, width selection and declaration-name collisions.
review110f_fixes.impact: impact110g.tsv: same 1817 input paths and classified rows as impact110f.tsv, 1586 corpus cases byte-identical to main, no timeouts or other differences.
review110f_fixes.integration_expectations: Frontend provenance now asserts collision rejection without emitted artifacts and accepts a noncolliding out-of-width scalar control. The original monitor-game collision source is retained, with additive records moving its rejection from monitor construction to expansion (status 3 to 2).

review110g_fixes.flattened_names: One complete arena-allocated/interned name constructor is shared by formula/key atoms, flattened declarations and declaration collision checks. Audited expansion, interners, identity keys and all library output printers: no other source-derived fixed name buffers on this path. LTL/LaTeX/quoted-LTL and TLSF printers stream full names.
review110g_fixes.recursive_instantiation: Each function call copies its declaration type graph independently, preserving argument/result sharing within the instance. Recursive actuals never unify with caller formals. A fixed point propagates real type constraints through recursive/mutual calls; type copying and convergence have 2000-level guards matching expansion.
review110g_fixes.index_bounds: Evaluated indices must lie within the resolved declared bus interval before producing an atom, including aliases, actuals and stored-set keys. Negative/out-of-range accesses reject with the resolved bus name, offending index and bounds; unselected accesses are not evaluated.
review110g_fixes.exact_alias_widths: Static width validation follows only exact nullary identifier alias chains, using the alias declaration GLOBAL environment. It applies in unused definitions/unselected branches. Shadowed variables, selected/computed bus values and filtered domains retain exact checks against the actual expanded bus; no width propagation through type constraints.
review110g_fixes.regressions: 19 exact review110h probes appended to the review manifest; 341 additional paired/rejection cases, for 931 CLI cases plus 3 basic-TLSF complete-name roundtrips. C scope units add long-name, recursive/mutual-instantiation, true type-error, resolved index and exact alias-width checks.
review110g_fixes.impact: impact110h.tsv: same 1817 paths; 1586 corpus cases accepted with byte-identical output to main, zero corpus changes/out-of-range rejections, zero timeouts or other differences. The six pre-existing test-input differences retain their prior classifications.
review110g_fixes.historical_artifacts: No historical golden, fixture or ledger changed. Existing previous_sha256 and preserved artifact bindings retained; current hashes refreshed additively.

review110h_fixes.bus_bounds: Shared unresolved/visiting/resolved declaration states resolve referenced bus bounds in the GLOBAL environment before SIZEOF, indexing, identity-key and enum-width reads. All declarations resolve before static width/name checks; cycles reject with a diagnostic instead of reading placeholder bounds. Dependency-state allocations short-circuit on the first failure, preserving the existing objective_alloc fault-sweep invariant.
review110h_fixes.fairness_binder: Keep __tlsf_fair_i when unused; otherwise suffix until unused among inputs, outputs, parameters, definitions/functions, enum labels and enum types. The declaration freshness checker remains unchanged.
review110h_fixes.regressions: 22 additional CLI cases bring the total to 953, plus three complete-name basic-TLSF roundtrips and a fresh-fairness TLSF roundtrip. Cover both exact width examples, forward/chained/alias dependencies, cycles through SIZEOF/index/enum keys, actual enum widths, every global declaration category for fairness collisions, suffix retries and unchanged compound-guard rejection. C scope units add the two width examples and cycles; internal set-dedup setup supplies the shared dependency state.
review110h_fixes.historical_artifacts: Existing previous_sha256 and preserved-artifact bindings retained. Add src/lib/spec.c source binding and refresh current source/test/document hashes; no historical golden, fixture or ledger changed.
review110h_fixes.impact: impact110i.tsv: same 1817 paths and byte-identical TSV to impact110h.tsv; 1586 corpus cases accepted with byte-identical output to main, zero corpus changes, timeouts or other differences.
